cim: Scm Group earns innovation award for artificial intelligence applied to surface finishing
cim_eredeti: Scm Group earns innovation award for artificial intelligence applied to surface finishing
szoveg_eredeti:
The Scm Group has developed an innovative product dedicated to mechanical surface finishing processes, which received an award on November 4 at the 20th edition of SMAU in Milan.

SMAU (Salone Macchine e Attrezzature d'Ufficio) is one of Italy's leading information and communications technology events that honors outstanding industrial innovation and digital transformation.

Scm's award-winning innovation consists of an artificial intelligence-based process configurator integrated into its DMC machines for sanding wood and metal. It transforms a decades-long archive of data and scientific tests into a fully-fledged digital assistant, designed to guide both SCM sales teams in machine configuration and industry operators in selecting the right processing parameters.

Operations such as sanding, calibration and deburring require the precise combination of numerous variables, including working speed, pressure, type of material and abrasive loads. SCM has built on the know-how developed since 1956 for its DMC range of machines, incorporating scientific measurements carried out in its own laboratories. A substantial body of qualitative and quantitative data has thus been encoded into proprietary algorithms that outperform generic language models.The result is a process configurator that integrates directly into the human-machine interface (HMI) of the workstation, providing specialised responses based on SCM's real-world experience and tailored to the customer's specific application requirements.

The application is designed as a dynamic, constantly evolving system. According to the company, every new application tested by SCM in real-world conditions will progressively enrich its knowledge base, enabling the company to expand and refine the range of solutions available to support its customers.

“Adopting this configurator brings operational and economic benefits across the entire value chain,” explains Alessandro Caramia, product manager and business developer at SCM. “The configurator is designed to reduce setup times and make it easier to set processing parameters, with estimated time savings of up to 20% in the applications considered.

“Within the company, the tool also guides the sales team in configuring systems optimally during the quotation stage, providing accurate estimates of processing times, costs and productivity, while offering SCM opportunities to develop future software update services.”

The SMAU Innovation Award was collected by Bruno Di Napoli, Business Unit Manager of SCM's surface treatment solutions, and Sara Iaconianni, Scm Group's Scouting, Idea Management & Idea Generation Manager.

Larry Adams is a Chicago-based writer and editor who writes about how things get done. A former wire service and community newspaper reporter, Larry is an award-winning writer with more than three decades of experience. In addition to writing about woodworking, he has covered science, metrology, metalworking, industrial design, quality control, imaging, Swiss and micromanufacturing . He was previously a Tabbie Award winner for his coverage of nano-based coatings technology for the automotive industry. Larry volunteers for the historic preservation group, the Kalo Foundation/Ianelli Studios, and the science-based group, Chicago Council on Science and Technology (C2ST).
